title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
About Fora

Fora is the modern travel agency, redefining what it means to be a travel advisor in today’s world. We’re a next-generation platform that provides a comprehensive, business-in-a-box solution—combining cutting-edge technology, personalized training, a vibrant community, and exclusive industry partnerships—all designed to empower anyone with a passion for travel to turn that passion into a thriving business. Whether you're a travel enthusiast or an experienced professional, Fora equips you with everything needed to launch and scale a successful travel advisory business, making it the ultimate way to align work with your lifestyle.

At the heart of Fora is our mission: to power the next generation of travel entrepreneurs to transform their love for travel into a fulfilling full-time or part-time career, offering unparalleled flexibility, autonomy, and support. We believe that everyone, from seasoned travel professionals to first-time entrepreneurs, can build a career that’s both profitable and aligned with their passions.

Our platform combines innovative technology with the human touch, offering:


Best-in-class training programs to help agents develop expert knowledge, no matter their starting point.
A powerful suite of tools for booking, client management, and marketing, ensuring agents can focus on delivering exceptional travel experiences.
Access to an engaged community of fellow advisors, fostering collaboration, support, and shared learning.
Exclusive partnerships with top travel brands, providing access to competitive rates, perks, and experiences that elevate advisors’ offerings.


Since our founding in 2021 by experienced travel entrepreneurs Henley Vazquez, Jake Peters, and Evan Frank, Fora has experienced rapid growth, expanding to a team of 180+ full-time employees based in downtown New York City. Earlier this year, we announced our $60 million Series B and C investment rounds, led by Thrive Capital and Insight Partners, with participation by previous investors including Forerunner and Heartcore Capital. This funding represents a vote of confidence in the enduring power of entrepreneurship, and secures our ability to build a category-defining travel brand. We have a vision for the future that leverages the best of humans and the best of technology to create the first truly unified platform for all travel needs - from staycation to the safari.

We're proud of the recognition we've received, including:


LinkedIn’s Top Startups List 2024
Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025 and 2023
Built In 2025 Best Places to Work
And several "top agency" awards from our fantastic partners including Virtuoso, IHG, Four Seasons, and more


Fora is a mission-driven company that believes in the power of entrepreneurship, community, and passion. As we continue to grow, we are looking for more talented and like-minded individuals to join our team - people who are excited about transforming the travel space and helping us scale our vision globally.

About The Role

Fora is hiring its first Senior Analytics Engineer to help scale how data is modeled, curated, and delivered across the company. As our centralized data team grows, we’re looking for a dedicated owner of the analytics transformation and metrics layer so analysts and stakeholders can access timely, reliable, and actionable insights.

This is a foundational role where you’ll establish analytics engineering standards, create trusted data marts and metric definitions, and improve data quality and performance across Fora’s data stack. This role reports to the Director, Data & Analytics and works closely with partners in Engineering, Product, Finance and Growth.

Key Responsibilities


Own and mature Fora’s analytics transformation layer, including the data models, context, and systems used to manage it
Build modern analytics foundations that power AI-driven insights and action (both in BI-tool native AI apps, as well as through the use of MCP servers)
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their needs, determine projects, and define requirements
Improve quality, reliability, and performance, including reducing latency and managing cost as our data scales
Promote a culture of data excellence through mentorship, documentation, and training
Contribute to broader Data team strategy, project prioritization, and the continuous evolution of analytics best practices


Requirements


5+ years of experience in data analytics, including 2+ in an analytics engineering or an equivalent role
Advanced SQL skills. Experience with Python is a plus
Experience building and maintaining dbt projects in a production environment
Hands-on with data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks
Experience with modern BI tools such as Omni, Sigma, Hex, or Looker
Familiarity with data ingestion (Airbyte, Fivetran) or orchestration tools
Experience using LLM tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or OpenAI Codex
Strong cross-functional communication skills and experience partnering with technical and non-technical stakeholders


Compensation

Compensation for this role varies based on experience, with an indicative range of $130–$185K + equity. Final compensation will depend on the level at which the candidate is hired, as we’re considering multiple levels for this role.


Unlimited vacation
Health Insurance (including an option completely covered by Fora HQ)
Dental & Vision Insurance
Wellhub Memberships
401k plan with company match
Commuter Benefits
Supplemental Life Insurance
Stock Options


This role is based in our beautiful New York City office (Tribeca/Fidi) with lots of natural light and great views.

Our Values

We’re forging our own path

Fora has always been about driving change within the industry. We’re not interested in maintaining the status quo.

We’re stronger together

Community is our cornerstone and collective power is our strength. We believe we can all go further when we operate together, using our combined leverage to unlock better opportunities and outcomes for our advisors, partners, and travelers.

We believe in technology

We believe technology is an answer to some of the most fundamental challenges the travel industry faces. We believe advancements in AI, bold investments in our platforms, and a world-class data infrastructure will transform the work of our advisors and our partners, while creating better travel experiences for travelers.

We’re here to serve

We operate in service of our community and believe that when they’re empowered to focus on what they do best, we all win. It’s why we relentlessly advocate for our advisors and prioritize their best interest every step of the way.

We mean business

Fora is equal parts fun, meaningful work and serious travel business. We’re unlocking opportunities for thousands of travel entrepreneurs, delivering a stream of high-quality guests at scale for our partners, and providing a superior travel experience for our travelers. It’s a better equation for the future of our industry.





WORK AUTHORIZATION

You must have authorization to work in the United States. Fora is unable to assist applicants with obtaining work authorization.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Fora is committed to an equitable hiring process and an inclusive work environment. BIPOC and traditionally underrepresented candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. We will not discriminate and will take action to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, upgrading, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the bases of race, color, gender, national origin, age, religion, creed, disability, veteran's status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
About Genius AI

Genius AI is building technology to help local businesses run themselves. Genius AI products do the admin work that keeps practitioners from the work they love and the people they serve. From GlossGenius to Reception, its products work 24/7 on busywork like booking, marketing, client management, finances, staff and inventory management, and more.

Genius AI technology has saved businesses 106M in admin hours, earned them $2.0B in additional revenue, and facilitated more than 624M client touch points.

About The Role

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you'll own how Genius AI models, defines, and trusts its data. You sit at the intersection of data and the business, curating data so that it can be used to drive insights, strategy, and decision making. Our agentic products are scaling and our architecture is moving toward a more software-oriented model, which means the dbt project you design now will set the standard for how we understand customer behavior and how our AI-powered products make decisions. You won't inherit a finished playbook. You'll write one, and you'll ship changes in days, not quarters, with the judgment to know when to slow down. We expect you to challenge how we work, not just execute against it.

You will report to the Analytics Engineering Manager. You must be commutable to our NYC headquarters and will operate in an in-person environment. We default to being in-office 3–4 days per week with required attendance on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

What You'll Do


Own the architecture of our dbt project, including design patterns, modeling standards, and the best practices that keep a fast-growing codebase consistent through staging, intermediate, and mart layers
Partner with PDE (product, design, engineering) teams to support new features and architectural changes by reviewing design docs, creating or updating dbt models as data sources evolve, and validating that metrics, reports, and downstream consumers stay accurate
Build, refactor, and optimize dbt models that turn raw product and customer data into accurate, scalable datasets, iterating on a weekly cadence and correcting fast when the data says we're wrong
Use AI to build, not just work: design automated testing, documentation, and data-access workflows that scale beyond your own capacity and free your judgment for the problems that need it
Collaborate with data engineering to shape ingestion and transformation pipelines across Segment, Fivetran, and Airflow as we move toward a software-oriented architecture
Drive data privacy, governance, and quality standards that protect the integrity of the data our customers trust us with


What We're Looking For


5+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, or reporting engineer, with 2+ years of hands-on dbt development
You've built AI-assisted workflows for modeling, testing, or documentation rather than only using AI-assisted editors
Default to action: you set a direction, ship something, and iterate on what you learn instead of waiting weeks for perfect alignment
Advanced SQL proficiency, with a track record of writing models that stay fast and readable as data volume grows
Hands-on experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT development principles, and data warehousing concepts
Familiarity with our stack (Snowflake, dbt, Hex, Segment, Matia, Fivetran, Airflow) preferred


Benefits & Perks


Competitive health & dental insurance options, effective on your first day of employment
Flexible PTO
In-office lunch twice per week for NYC and SF employees, plus late night dinner stipends
Access to Wellhub, a corporate wellness platform with discounted gym memberships, fitness classes, and mental health resources
Annual stipend for professional development and continued learning
High performers at 5 years receive a $5,000 bonus to use however you recharge best
401k benefit: employees are eligible to contribute starting day 1 of employment
Dependent Care FSA
Paid parental leave
Fertility and adoption benefits via Carrot and Kindbody


At Genius AI, we celebrate our differences and are committed to creating a workplace where all employees feel supported and empowered to do their best work. We believe this benefits not only our employees but our product, customers, and community as well. Genius AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer.

Personal Information: Notice at Collection for Employees and Applicants

Agency Submissions

If a resume or applicant is submitted to Genius AI by a third party without a signed search agreement in place, it will become the property of Genius AI and no fee will be paid, irrespective of whether the candidate is hired.

Genius AI may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence and machine learning systems (AI Tools), to assist in evaluating applicants’ qualifications and fitness for the position. These AI Tools may be used alongside human review during one or more stages of the recruiting process, including application screening, skills assessments, and interviewing. No final hiring decision will be made solely by AI Tools without human oversight.

Compensation Range: $175K - $205K

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As a Data Engineer, you will be an early member of the Data Science & Analytics team building the foundation to scale analytics across our organization. You will collaborate with key stakeholders in Engineering, Product, GTM and other areas to build scalable solutions to transform data into key metrics reporting and insights. You will be responsible for ensuring teams have access to reliable, accurate metrics that can scale with our company’s growth. You will also lead your own projects to enable self-serve insights to help teams make data-driven decisions.

Responsibilities


Understand the data needs of stakeholder teams in terms of key data models and reporting, and translate that into technical requirements
Define, build and manage key data pipelines in dbt that transform raw logs into canonical datasets
Establish high data integrity standards and SLAs to ensure timely, accurate delivery of data
Develop insightful and reliable dashboards to track performance of core metrics that will deliver insights to the whole company
Build foundational data products, dashboards and tools to enable self-serve analytics to scale across the company
Influence the future roadmap of Product and GTM teams from a data systems perspective
Become an expert in our organization’s data models and the company's data architecture


You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have


5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar Data Science & Analytics roles, preferably partnering with GTM and Product leads to build and report on key company-wide metrics.
A passion for the company's mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI.
Expertise in building multi-step ETL jobs, building robust data models through tooling like dbt; proficiency with workflow management platforms like Airflow and version control management tools through GitHub.
Expertise in SQL and Python to transform data into accurate, clean data models.
Experience building data reporting and dashboarding in visualization tools like Hex to serve multiple cross-functional teams.
A bias for action and urgency, not letting perfect be the enemy of the effective.
A “full-stack mindset”, not hesitating to do what it takes to solve a problem end-to-end, even if it requires going outside the original job description.
Experience building an Analytics Data Engineering (or similar) function at start-ups.
A strong disposition to thrive in ambiguity, taking initiative to create clarity and forward progress.


The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Manager, Analytical Engineer
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Job Description: The Manager of Analytics Engineering provides hands-on technical expertise to develop, deploy, and maintain both core data models and core data layer infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on building robust, scalable, and well-documented data models and pipelines, while also enabling self-service analytics across the organization.

We are seeking a highly skilled Analytical Engineer to join our team. This role bridges the gap between data engineering and data analytics, focusing on data architecture, quality, and governance. The ideal candidate will have experience designing and maintaining dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas), including fact and dimension table design, slowly changing dimensions (SCD), and conformed dimensions across multiple subject areas. This role requires strong technical expertise in data transformation, modeling, and pipeline optimization. Additionally, a successful candidate is an excellent communicator who can effectively explain complex technical information to a wide variety of stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities and Major Duties


Collaborate with the business to gather requirements and deliver data-products to enable data-informed decision-making.
Develop a centralized data-layer to deliver data-products at scale to the business.

title: Data Analyst (Entry-Level)
description:
Overview

Location: Remote, New York City, or Oakland, CA


Travel is encouraged approximately once per year to state partners within the continental USA, and occasionally required. We expect these trips to include visits to prisons and parole offices.


Role Type: Full-time

Compensation: $85,000

Visa sponsorship: Not available

Hires remotely in: United States

Experience: 6+ months of professional work experience, including internships or research

Recidiviz is thrilled to be hiring a Data Analyst to join our team! We're a small, fast-moving group that works with complex criminal justice data from our state partners and develops analyses and tools that target the drivers of incarceration. That's where you come in. We're looking for someone early in their data career who brings attention to detail to our analyses, curiosity to dig into unfamiliar and messy data, clarity in explaining what they find, flexibility to adjust in a rapidly evolving environment, and above all else, a collaborative, kind nature to add to our culture.

About Us

Recidiviz is creating safer, healthier communities by improving outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We build technology to reduce the number of people in prison and to help criminal justice leaders embrace data-driven decision-making.

Using software tools and thoughtful product design, we've been able to safely and permanently reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with leaders of the criminal justice system, people in prison and on supervision, and ecosystem partners to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from state partners, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations support our work.

People who succeed at Recidiviz lead with kindness and humility, assume good intent, learn from failure, and fix problems when they see them. They are excited to work arm in arm with government leadership and staff to improve outcomes. They are great listeners. They build deep relationships with and empathy for the people we work with and the people who our mission serves, even when those two groups feel at odds.

About The Role

This role works alongside experienced analysts and teammates across several teams on work that targets the drivers of incarceration. Our Data Analysts work with diverse data (criminal justice data both raw and processed from across the country, reports and policy documents from government agencies, and much more) to develop our understanding of the criminal justice system and to motivate change. In this role, you'll carry out well-defined analyses, build clear visualizations with our existing tools, and support product launches by preparing the data each product needs in each state. You'll share your findings with teams across Recidiviz and, alongside teammates, with our state partners.

Core Responsibilities


Exploring our datasets to find patterns and insights about American criminal justice systems
Carrying out well-scoped analyses with guidance from senior analysts and our State Engagement team
Supporting product launches in the states where we work by following established launch processes, preparing the analytical data each launch needs, and flagging data discrepancies as they come up
Building clear, well-documented visualizations and dashboards using our existing tools
Communicating findings to internal teams, and presenting to state partners alongside teammates
Analyzing trends in areas related to our own work to understand how our products function


Wild success

A Year From Now


You've contributed to real impact. Your analyses have supported product launches in the states you work with and have helped measure the impact those tools are having on the justice system.
You've become a go-to analyst for your states. You know their data, policies, and products well, and you answer new questions with growing independence and the right tool for each job.


Minimum Qualifications


Strong communication and collaboration skills, to help nurture a knowledgeable, data-oriented culture
Enthusiasm for working with internal and external partners from diverse backgrounds and worldviews, such as government staff, researchers, journalists, technical staff, and practitioners in criminal justice reform
Care and curiosity in inspecting source data and checking results closely, so the data and analyses you prepare can be trusted and reused
6 or more months of practical experience exploring, analyzing, and cleaning real-world datasets. Internships and research count, and part-time roles count when their hours add up to roughly 6 months of full-time work.
Working proficiency in SQL, including joins, aggregations, and window functions
Familiarity with Python, specifically the Pandas package, for data analysis and visualization


Preferred Qualifications


Interest in criminal justice or public policy, or experience working with public-sector data
Experience with a BI or dashboarding tool such as Looker or Tableau
Familiarity with any part of our data stack, which includes Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Looker, Jupyter notebooks, and Python/Pandas


Compensation

Compensation is standardized based on roles and responsibilities. This ensures equitable compensation and responsible stewardship of our resources. As such, we do not negotiate compensation offers.

The annual compensation for this role is: $85,000.

What We Offer


Effective, extremely thoughtful colleagues, working together on a mission that matters
90% medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for you and your dependents
Flexible time off, including 20 days of PTO, 3 days of paid volunteering time, and 13 paid holidays
12 weeks of paid parental leave
401(k) retirement plan with 5% company match and no vesting period
Complimentary One Medical membership (depending on location)
Partnership with Carrot to provide employees with inclusive fertility and family-forming benefits, as well as a small but growing number of hormonal health and gender-affirming care benefits
Monthly ClassPass credit for personal wellness
Free mental health support via Talkspace
Well-located offices in Oakland and Manhattan, with the flexibility to work remotely or go into either office as you choose
An annual company offsite each spring and other ad-hoc gatherings
All the exhilarating challenges and stretch opportunities of a tech startup, combined with the mission-driven heart of a nonprofit


More About Recidiviz

Recidiviz was an all-volunteer effort until early 2019, when Clementine, Andrew, and Joshua founded the organization. Since then, we've built an A-team of software engineers, designers, product managers and domain experts, from companies like Google, Apple, Dropbox, Opower, and Sidewalk Labs. Recidiviz was part of Y-Combinator's 2019 class and has received support from some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations, including Ford Foundation, Mackenzie Scott, Schmidt Futures, Arnold Ventures, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and the Mozilla Foundation.

Today, Recidiviz works with (and earns revenue from) over 19 state partners – big and small, red and blue – and covers more than 45% of the US incarcerated population. We have helped to get tens of thousands of people out of the criminal justice system, safely and equitably, and saved states nearly $1 billion. In the next five years, Recidiviz plans to partner with 40 states and help 250,000 people who are stuck in the system to get out and stay out. In addition to partnering with state Departments of Corrections, Recidiviz collaborates with and learns from partners – from organizations like the Correctional Leaders Association (CLA) to community based organizations and justice-impacted individuals, whose perspectives guide our work.

To learn more about how we do what we do, check out our 2024 Year in Review, read some press coverage, or watch our TED Talk. And if you're really keen to see our work, you can dive into our Github :).

An important note

Lasting change is always built on diversity. Recidiviz recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, gender identity and all protected status as required by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a special need that requires accommodation, please let us know in your application. Even if you don't think you meet all the criteria above, drop your resume, and we'll take a look – you might be great for another role or another time!

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Company

Shared Services

Argo and Farm Family are specialty property and casualty insurance brands whose underwriting companies are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Clearbrook Holdings Inc. Argo and Farm Family partner with agents and brokers to provide insurance solutions that enable businesses to manage risks with confidence.

Job Description

The Senior Data Analyst plays a critical role in advancing the organization's regulatory reporting, data quality, and analytical capabilities. This position owns the end-to-end transformation of complex policy, claims, underwriting, and financial data into accurate, timely, and compliant regulatory submissions while driving improvements in data processes, governance, and reporting standards.

As a senior analytical professional, this role combines advanced data analysis, data engineering, insurance domain expertise, and business insight to solve complex data challenges, influence decision-making, and identify opportunities that improve operational effectiveness and regulatory compliance. The Senior Data Analyst serves as a trusted partner to business and technical stakeholders and provides mentorship and guidance to analysts across the organization.

Essential Responsibilities


Design and execute advanced analyses to support regulatory reporting, compliance initiatives, and strategic business decisions.
Transform complex business requirements into scalable data solutions, analytical frameworks, and actionable insights.
Analyze policy, claims, underwriting, financial, and operational data to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, data models, reconciliations, and datasets to improve performance, scalability, and reusability.
Partner with Data Engineering and Application teams to design and implement data enrichment, transformation, and integration solutions.
Support and enhance data platforms, reporting processes, and analytical assets using modern data technologies and best practices.
Own data preparation, validation, and reconciliation activities supporting statutory reporting, regulatory filings, annual statement reporting, premium tax reporting, market conduct examinations, audits, and ad hoc regulatory requests.
Develop deep expertise in Property & Casualty insurance operations, regulatory reporting requirements, and statutory accounting principles.
Ensure analytical outputs align with regulatory expectations and support sound business decision-making.
Translate regulatory and business requirements into sustainable data processes and controls.
Independently diagnose data quality, integration, and reporting issues across multiple systems and business functions.
Perform root-cause analysis and develop sustainable corrective actions that improve data integrity and reporting accuracy.
Design analytical approaches for complex or ambiguous business problems where requirements may be incomplete or evolving.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve efficiency, and enhance data accessibility for business stakeholders.
Build strong partnerships with Compliance, Finance, Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, MGA Operations, Applications, and Data Engineering teams.
Effectively communicate complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop clear narratives that connect data insights to regulatory, operational, and business outcomes.
Challenge assumptions, provide data-driven recommendations, and influence prioritization of data and reporting initiatives.
Champion data governance practices and contribute to the development of data standards, controls, documentation, and definitions.
Establish and enhance data quality monitoring processes within assigned domains.
Serve as a subject matter resource for analytical methodologies, reporting practices, and regulatory data requirements.
Mentor and provide guidance to analysts by reviewing analytical approaches, sharing best practices, and supporting professional development.
Promote a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and analytical excellence.


Qualifications & Experience Required


Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, business analytics, computer science, actuarial science, finance, or a related quantitative field.
5+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics, regulatory reporting, or related functions within the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
Demonstrated experience supporting regulatory reporting, statutory reporting, compliance initiatives, or financial reporting processes.
Strong knowledge of insurance operations and data structures across policy, claims, underwriting, accounting, finance, or actuarial functions.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale relational databases, data warehouses, and data transformation methodologies.
Experience performing complex data analysis, reconciliation, root-cause investigation, and data quality assessments.
Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
Proven ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Strong verbal, written, presentation, and data storytelling skills.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree in quantitative, analytical, or business-related discipline.
Experience with Snowflake, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical and visualization platforms.
Experience with data governance frameworks, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality programs.
Intermediate or advanced Property & Casualty insurance designations (CPCU, AINS, AU, API, or equivalent).
Experience partnering with Actuarial teams and supporting actuarial, financial, or regulatory reporting processes.
Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern data engineering concepts.


Key Competencies


Technical & Analytical Skills - Designs advanced analyses, metrics, and scalable data solutions while improving performance, quality, and reusability of datasets and reporting assets.
Business Acumen & Domain Knowledge - Applies deep Property & Casualty insurance and regulatory expertise to connect analytical work with broader business objectives and outcomes.
Problem Solving & Critical Thinking - Independently solves complex, ambiguous problems and develops analytical approaches from the ground up.
Communication & Data Storytelling - Translates complex data into clear, compelling narratives that influence business decisions and drive action.
Stakeholder Management & Influence - Builds trusted partnerships across functions, challenges assumptions constructively, and helps guide analytical priorities.
Leadership & Mentorship - Provides informal leadership through mentoring, knowledge sharing, review of analytical work, and coaching of other analysts.
Data Quality & Governance - Improves data quality standards, governance practices, and reporting controls within the domain.
Strategic Thinking & Innovation - Connects analytics to broader organizational goals and identifies high-impact opportunities for process improvement, automation, and operational effectiveness.

We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives, and a comprehensive benefits program—including health, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

title: Analyst Financial Planning and Analysis
description:
Position Title: Analyst Financial Planning and Analysis – Loyalty & Revenue

Position Summary

The Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis – Loyalty & Revenue supports JetBlue’s Loyalty and Revenue Management teams through financial planning, reporting, data analysis, and recurring FP&A processes. This role helps connect commercial performance, customer behavior, loyalty activity, and revenue trends to financial outcomes by preparing forecasts, variance analysis, dashboards, and business insights.

The Analyst will partner closely with Commercial FP&A leadership, Loyalty, Revenue Management, Revenue Analytics, Revenue Management Data Science, Accounting, IT, and other Finance teams. The ideal candidate has a strong business foundation, analytical curiosity, and experience using SQL or similar tools to extract, validate, and analyze data. This role is well suited for someone who can work with large datasets, understand business drivers, support recurring forecast processes, and clearly communicate insights to finance and commercial stakeholders.

Essential Responsibilities


Support recurring FP&A processes for Loyalty, including monthly close support, variance analysis, forecast updates, budget planning, OpEx tracking, CapEx tracking, and performance reporting
Prepare monthly and quarterly reporting packages that explain financial performance, key business drivers, risks, opportunities, and variances to forecast, budget, and prior year
Use Excel, Tableau, SQL, and other analytical tools to extract, validate, summarize, and analyze financial, commercial, loyalty, customer, and revenue data
Analyze drivers of Loyalty and Revenue Management performance, including revenue trends, redemption activity, customer behavior, partner performance, forecast assumptions, investment activity, and cost trends
Partner with Revenue Analytics, Revenue Management Data Science, Loyalty, and other Finance teams to understand analytical outputs and translate findings into financial implications, forecast updates, and business narratives
Maintain, update, and improve recurring financial models, reporting templates, dashboards, and process documentation
Support the development of financial forecasts, annual budgets, long-range plans, and business cases for Loyalty, Revenue Management, Paisly, and other Commercial initiatives
Assist with ad hoc analysis requested by Commercial FP&A leadership and business partners, including opportunity sizing, sensitivity analysis, trend analysis, and scenario modeling
Identify data quality issues, process gaps, and reporting inefficiencies; recommend improvements to increase accuracy, consistency, and automation.
Prepare materials for leadership discussions, including charts, exhibits, variance explanations, and concise written commentary.
Build strong working relationships across Commercial, Finance, Accounting, IT, Revenue Analytics, and Revenue Management Data Science teams.
Other duties as assigned.



Minimum Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting, Mathematics, Statistics, Analytics, Engineering, or another related field; OR demonstrated capability to perform job responsibilities with a combination of a High School Diploma/GED and previous relevant work experience.
Two (2) years of experience in Finance, Commercial, Revenue Management, Loyalty, Analytics, Consulting, Accounting, or another business-oriented analytical role.
Experience performing financial analysis, variance analysis, forecasting, budgeting, reporting, business-case support, or performance analysis.
Experience writing SQL queries or using SQL-based tools to extract, join, validate, and analyze data.
Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, including ability to organize data, build analysis, summarize findings, and prepare clear presentation materials.
Strong analytical skills, including ability to evaluate datasets, identify trends, connect analysis to business drivers, and communicate implications clearly.
Ability to work with analysis produced by other teams, understand core assumptions, identify key takeaways, and translate findings into financial impact.

title: Curacity - Sr. Analytics and Data Quality Analyst
description:
Are you ready to join Connecticut Innovation’s vibrant community of innovators? Connecticut Innovations (“CI”) is Connecticut’s strategic venture capital arm, and we are passionate about serving our portfolio of 220+ companies across various industries, with strengths in life sciences, technology, and climate tech.




Come join CI Portfolio Company, Curacity: Hotel marketing software that turns media into revenue!!




Location: New York City (Hybrid)




About Curacity




Curacity is a two-sided marketplace connecting travel brands that need to be discovered with the publishers, travel writers, and content creators travelers actually trust. Hotels and cruise brands define the editorial coverage they need; our network of publishers and creators produces original content; Curacity coordinates the fulfillment and measures the outcomes.




We operate two products on that network. Newsletter places original editorial recommendations in front of publisher subscriber audiences and ties the resulting bookings back to the content that drove them. Vista AI builds the distributed editorial footprint that determines whether a property gets recommended when a traveler asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Mode, or Gemini where to stay.




Curacity partners with publications including AFAR and Travel + Leisure, and was named among Inc. 5000's Top 20 Travel & Hospitality Companies and Digiday's Best Content Marketing Platform of 2024. We are headquartered in New York with an office in Stamford, CT.




Role Overview




Our reporting, attribution, and billing depend on data we receive from hotel partners and integration sources. When that data is incomplete, incorrectly mapped, or misunderstood, the impact can reach both our customers and our business.




We’re hiring a Senior Analytics & Data Quality Analyst to help us strengthen the reliability of that data and turn it into useful business insight.




This role will evolve over time. Initially, you will focus heavily on validating data during a major transition: investigating discrepancies, confirming that partner and property data has been migrated and mapped correctly, improving data hygiene, and helping establish repeatable quality controls. As that transition is completed and those processes mature, the role will broaden into general analytics, including developing dashboards, analyzing business performance, defining metrics, and producing actionable insights for teams across the company.




This is a strong fit for someone who combines analytical rigor with curiosity and practical judgment. You enjoy tracing an unexpected number back to its source, but you are equally interested in explaining what the data means and helping people make better decisions with it.




What You'll Do




Initially: validate and strengthen our data

Validate data associated with integrations, hotel onboarding, and our broader data transition.
Use SQL and other analytical tools to assess completeness, accuracy, consistency, expected ranges, referential integrity, and mapping to our internal data model.
Reconcile data across source systems, transformed datasets, reports, and billing outputs.
Investigate suspicious values, missing records, duplicate entities, attribution issues, and other inconsistencies.
Trace issues through ingestion, transformation, and reporting workflows to identify likely root causes.
Distinguish among internal defects, upstream source-data problems, mapping issues, and expected business behavior.
Document findings clearly and work with engineering, product, operations, and account teams to coordinate resolution.
Improve data-hygiene practices by identifying recurring issues and recommending validation rules, monitoring, automation, or process changes.
Help establish a repeatable approach to validating new data sources and newly onboarded properties.




Over time: expand into broader analytics

Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reporting for business and operational teams.
Analyze trends, performance drivers, and anomalies, translating findings into clear recommendations.
Partner with stakeholders to turn business questions into well-defined analyses and metrics.
Define and document important fields, KPIs, calculations, and business rules.
Improve the usability and trustworthiness of our reporting and analytics datasets.
Perform ad hoc analysis to support decisions across the company.
Continue monitoring high-risk data areas and improving quality controls as our data and products evolve.




Qualifications




Experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data quality, analytics engineering, or a related role.
Strong SQL skills, including the ability to investigate unfamiliar datasets, reconcile results across sources, and diagnose unexpected output.
Experience working with data pipelines and an understanding of how data moves through ingestion, transformation, warehousing, and reporting.
Experience validating data from external sources such as APIs, file feeds, partner platforms, or third-party integrations.
Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail. You test assumptions, look for edge cases, and do not treat a successful load as proof that the data is correct.
Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through a modern BI or visualization tool.
The ability to explain data issues and analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational and written communication skills, including the ability to document findings and requirements precisely.
Comfort working independently in an environment where some processes and definitions are still being established.
The ability to balance immediate investigation with longer-term improvements that reduce recurring work.







Nice to Have




Experience with Python or another scripting language for analysis, validation, or lightweight automation.
Experience with dbt tests, Great Expectations, Soda, Monte Carlo, or other data-quality and observability tools.
Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or a comparable platform.
Experience working with data that affects billing, revenue, attribution, or other financially sensitive workflows.
Familiarity with entity resolution, identity matching, or record-linkage problems.
Experience with hospitality, travel, marketing analytics, or advertising technology data.
Familiarity with orchestration tools and modern cloud data warehouses.
Experience improving data-quality or analytics practices in a growing organization.




What Success Looks Like




In your first 90 days: You understand our most important data sources, business definitions, and reporting workflows. You have helped validate high-priority data associated with our transition, established a consistent way to document and investigate discrepancies, and become a trusted partner for data questions.

During the transition: High-risk data is systematically reviewed, material discrepancies are identified and resolved, and recurring problems are converted into clearer rules, better monitoring, or more reliable processes. Stakeholders have visibility into validation progress and outstanding risks.

As the role evolves: You spend less time performing repetitive manual validation and more time helping teams understand and use the data. Core dashboards and metrics are reliable and well documented, business questions are answered with clear analysis, and data issues are increasingly detected before they affect customers or financial workflows.




Why This Role Is Interesting




This role offers the opportunity to shape both how we trust our data and how we use it.

You will have immediate, concrete responsibility during an important transition, with direct visibility into data that affects customers, reporting, attribution, and billing. You will also have room to improve the systems and processes behind that work so the role can develop into a broader analytics function focused on insights, dashboards, and decision support.




It is a good opportunity for an analyst who likes solving detailed data problems but does not want to remain limited to quality assurance or operational validation.




Why Curacity?




You'll join an award-winning, fast-growing team at the intersection of luxury travel, analytics, and modern media. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape the measurement and pricing infrastructure behind a high-growth hospitality technology company.




Equal Opportunity




Curacity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
